Ship.title: Shipments VN → MM
Ship.receiveHint: Batches are linked when a receive document selects this shipment.

Products.copyHelp: Choose and load a product before entering details. Content, prices, variants and images are copied; stock and transactions are excluded. Enter a new slug and SKUs. The copy is hidden by default and created only when you save.
Products.copyLoaded: Loaded from: {name}. Edit the details below; images are copied when you save.
Products.title: Products
Products.name: Name
Products.label: Variant name (size/shade)
Products.importHelp: Download the Excel template, fill in the San pham sheet starting at row 7, then upload the .xlsx file directly. One row per variant; use the same product code to group variants. Create categories first. CSV is also supported, up to 2 MB.
Products.stockHelp: Fill in the Ton dau ky sheet in the Excel template. Creates draft receive documents per warehouse; review each document, then Post. Do not re-import stock already posted.
Products.imagesHelp: JPG/PNG/WebP, up to 5MB each; you can pick several. The first image is the cover.
Products.requiresExpiry: Track expiry dates for this product
Products.checkPrice: Active variants have a positive selling price

confirmHint.BANK_TRANSFER: Check the bank account and confirm only after receiving the correct order amount.

Pricing.title: Prices & exchange rate
Pricing.rateHint: Enter USD → MMK and USD → VND; the MMK ↔ VND rate is calculated automatically.
Pricing.formula: Price = VND cost (latest batch) ÷ rate (VND per 1 MMK) × (1 + margin %), rounded up
Pricing.noCost: No cost yet (no batch received), cannot be priced
Pricing.changedSince: Price edited after preview — will be skipped
Pricing.applyConfirm: Apply new prices to the selected lines?
Pricing.noRate: No exchange rate yet — add one first

Quarantine.title: Quarantine (returned goods)
Quarantine.hint: Inspect returned goods: restock if sellable, otherwise discard.

Alerts.title: Stock alerts
Alerts.note: Stop selling below {block} days, warn below {warn} days. Sales velocity over the last {window} days, cover {cover} days after arrival. Change in Settings.
Alerts.reorderHint: Suggest = sold/day × (lead time + cover days) + safety stock − (available + VN + inbound).

Reports.title: Reports
Reports.basis: Revenue = goods value of orders completed in the period (by completion date, Yangon time), net of returns. Profit = revenue − cost of issued lots. Shipping fees shown separately.
Reports.slow: Slow movers (in stock, no sales in {days} days)
Reports.missingCost: Orders with lots missing landed cost (counted as 0) — allocate shipment costs for accurate profit:

VtpExport.title: Export orders to VTP Myanmar
VtpExport.description: Select up to 200 orders preparing for delivery. Exports preserve the supplied OMS template and its 21 columns.
VtpExport.senderHint: Select the sender address in VTP; the template has no sender column. Review service, COD and charge payer before creating shipments.
VtpExport.empty: No orders preparing for delivery to export.
VtpExport.reviewHint: Weights are in grams; adjust them for the packed parcel. Complete missing weights and addresses before exporting. Notes include the second phone number when available. Edits on this page apply only to the exported file.
VtpExport.addressMissing: Address not matched to the VTP template. Verify and choose:
VtpExport.noTransition: Exporting does not ship orders or issue stock.
VtpExport.singleHint: Copy each field into the VTP single-order form. Choose the sender address and service in your VTP account.
VtpExport.copyFallback: Select the field value and press Ctrl+C to copy.

Opening.title: Start selling · Import products and opening stock
Opening.help: One workbook with two input sheets linked by SKU. New products stay unpublished; inventory takes effect after posting the receipt.
Opening.warehouse: Default warehouse for blank warehouse cells
Opening.costHelp: Preview amounts are MMK per unit. Landed cost includes purchase and inbound costs at the current rate. Estimated profit deducts entered selling fees, excluding undeclared costs and affiliate commissions.
Opening.confirmHelp: Confirmation creates unpublished products and draft receipts. UNKNOWN stock is not sellable. Selling fees are used for this estimate only. Publish after checking images, prices and posting stock.
Opening.success: Created {count} variants. Next: review and post the receipts below.
Opening.testHelp: Before launch: finish images and content, test a COD and a bank-transfer order, check inventory and VTP export.

Cod.title: COD reconciliation
Cod.help: Delivery completion records customer payment to the carrier. Confirm remittance only after checking the receiving account and carrier statement.
Cod.outstanding: {count} orders awaiting remittance · Gross COD {amount} MMK (before carrier deductions)
